title: Took vg-paradigms release 2026.10.20 by its auto subscription
body:
The dry run broke nothing: no rule it would newly break, no license it would block. What moved:
- ~ checks.contract: Tests and benchmarks follow tend's check contract: its published, versioned check schema (kind, command, needs, unit), where needs come from the estate's capability vocabulary (thalam's export). Exit codes follow the automake convention: 0 passed, 1 failed, 77 skipped because it can't run here (the reason on stderr), 99 broken. Results, on request, are JUnit XML for tests and Bencher's BMF for benchmarks. A command never prompts, runs on the pinned runtime with `--locked`, and is idempotent if it changes anything; a benchmark runs on the real machine, alone, best of N, compared only with the same machine's. Gates are tend's, not the project's code.
